title: How AI could change the skills you need
titleChinese: 人工智能将如何改变你所需掌握的技能
paragraphs: Are you worried that you can't keep up with AI? Current artificial intelligence systems can do many tasks much quicker than we can. Does this mean that machines will put us out of work?

Rather than replace our jobs, it may be more likely that AI will transform the way we work. Previous waves of mechanisation and automation did not cause lasting effects to employment rates. However, the skills valued by the economy could change. Research from Goldman Sachs shows some evidence that AI has affected the US job market differently in different sectors. Being adaptable and understanding how AI and humans can best work together in the industry that you work in is likely to become very important.

Humans and artificial intelligence have different strengths. AI systems are naturally best suited to tasks that are repetitive, involve data and that are very large. Humans usually perform best when skills and qualities such as leadership, empathy and judgement are required. Recent research from MIT's Sloan School of Management identified which tasks were best done by humans, and which were best done by AI. They found that where humans were better, working together with AI boosted performance above that of humans working alone. Creative tasks could be an area where this collaboration is particularly productive. Professor David Stilwell from Cambridge University highlights that AI's creativity is currently at a similar level to an average human. Other research shows that using ideas generated by AI, even bad ones, helps humans to come up with better ideas more quickly.

Companies need to look at their workflows and processes to see where using AI alone or in collaboration with humans can be more efficient. They can then decide how best to integrate AI into their workflow. Employees should try to learn how best to use AI to support themselves. Being able to do this effectively will help lead to career success.
chineseParagraphs: 你是否担心自己跟不上人工智能的发展？当前的人工智能系统处理许多任务的速度远超我们人类。这是否意味着机器将让我们失业？
人工智能或许更可能改变我们的工作方式，而非直接取代我们的工作。以往的机械化和自动化浪潮并未对就业率造成持久影响。然而，经济所看重的技能可能会发生变化。高盛的研究展示了一些相关证据，人工智能对美国就业市场的影响因行业而异。具备适应能力，并理解在你所处的行业中，人工智能与人类如何实现最佳协作，这一点可能会变得至关重要。

人类与人工智能各有其优势。人工智能系统天然最适合处理那些重复性的、涉及大量数据的任务。而人类通常在需要领导力、同理心和判断力等技能与品质时表现最佳。麻省理工学院斯隆管理学院的最新研究明确了哪些任务最适合由人类完成，哪些最适合由人工智能完成。他们发现，在人类擅长的领域，与人工智能协作能提升绩效，使其优于人类单独工作。创意性任务可能是这种人机协作尤其富有成效的领域。剑桥大学的戴维·斯蒂尔韦尔教授指出，人工智能当前的创造力水平与普通人类相当。另有研究表明，即使使用人工智能生成的平庸甚至糟糕的点子，也能帮助人类更快地产生更好的想法。
公司需要审视其工作流程和工序，以确定在哪些环节单独使用人工智能或与人类协作能提高效率。然后，然后他们可以决定如何最好地将人工智能整合到工作流程中。员工应努力学习如何最好地利用人工智能来支持自身工作。能够有效地做到这一点，将有助于取得职业成功。

vocabulary.entry: keep up with /ˌkiːp ˈʌp wɪð/ phr. v. 跟上，与……同步（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: It's hard to keep up with all the latest developments in technology.
vocabulary.translation: 跟上所有最新的技术发展很难。

vocabulary.entry: put out of work /ˌpʊt aʊt əv ˈwɜːk/ phr. 使失业（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Automation has put many factory workers out of work.
vocabulary.translation: 自动化使许多工厂工人失业了。

vocabulary.entry: transform /trænsˈfɔːm/ v. 改变，转变（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The internet has transformed the way we communicate.
vocabulary.translation: 互联网改变了我们的沟通方式。

vocabulary.entry: mechanisation /ˌmekənaɪˈzeɪʃn/ n. 机械化（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The mechanisation of farming has increased productivity.
vocabulary.translation: 农业机械化提高了生产力。

vocabulary.entry: automation /ˌɔːtəˈmeɪʃn/ n. 自动化（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Automation is replacing many routine jobs.
vocabulary.translation: 自动化正在取代许多常规工作。

vocabulary.entry: lasting /ˈlɑːstɪŋ/ adj. 持久的，长期的
vocabulary.example: The experience left a lasting impression on her.
vocabulary.translation: 这次经历给她留下了持久的印象。

vocabulary.entry: employment rate /ɪmˈplɔɪmənt reɪt/ n. 就业率（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The employment rate has risen steadily over the past year.
vocabulary.translation: 过去一年就业率稳步上升。

vocabulary.entry: sector /ˈsektə(r)/ n. 行业，部门（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The manufacturing sector has seen significant job losses.
vocabulary.translation: 制造业部门经历了显著的失业。

vocabulary.definition: 能适应的，适应性强的（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: adaptable /əˈdæptəbl/ adj. 能适应的，适应性强的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: An adaptable workforce is essential in a changing economy.
vocabulary.translation: 一支适应性强的劳动力队伍在不断变化的经济中至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: work together /ˌwɜːk təˈɡeðə(r)/ phr. v. 合作，协作（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The two teams worked together to complete the project.
vocabulary.translation: 两个团队合作完成了这个项目。

vocabulary.entry: strength /streŋθ/ n. 优势，长处
vocabulary.example: Her main strength is her ability to work under pressure.
vocabulary.translation: 她的主要优势是能在压力下工作。

vocabulary.entry: repetitive /rɪˈpetətɪv/ adj. 重复的，单调的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The job was boring and repetitive.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作枯燥且重复。

vocabulary.entry: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ v. 包含，涉及
vocabulary.example: The job involves a lot of travel.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作涉及大量的出差。

vocabulary.definition: 领导力，领导才能（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: leadership /ˈliːdəʃɪp/ n. 领导力，领导才能（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Strong leadership is crucial for the success of any team.
vocabulary.translation: 强有力的领导力对任何团队的成功都至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: empathy /ˈempəθi/ n. 同理心，共情（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Empathy allows us to understand the feelings of others.
vocabulary.translation: 同理心让我们能够理解他人的感受。

vocabulary.entry: judgement /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/ n. 判断力，判断（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Good judgement is essential in making important decisions.
vocabulary.translation: 良好的判断力在做出重要决策时至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: collaboration /kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃn/ n. 协作，合作（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The project was the result of a collaboration between two universities.
vocabulary.translation: 这个项目是两所大学合作的成果。

vocabulary.entry: boost /buːst/ v. 促进，增强
vocabulary.example: Winning the competition boosted her confidence.
vocabulary.translation: 赢得比赛增强了她的信心。

vocabulary.entry: creative /kriˈeɪtɪv/ adj. 创造性的，有创意的
vocabulary.example: The job requires creative thinking.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作需要创造性思维。

vocabulary.entry: productive /prəˈdʌktɪv/ adj. 富有成效的，多产的
vocabulary.example: The meeting was very productive.
vocabulary.translation: 这次会议非常富有成效。

vocabulary.entry: generate /ˈdʒenəreɪt/ v. 产生，生成（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The new marketing campaign generated a lot of interest.
vocabulary.translation: 新的营销活动引起了广泛关注。

vocabulary.entry: come up with /ˌkʌm ˈʌp wɪð/ phr. v. 想出，提出（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: She came up with a brilliant idea for the project.
vocabulary.translation: 她为这个项目想出了一个绝妙的主意。

vocabulary.entry: workflow /ˈwɜːkfləʊ/ n. 工作流程（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The new software has improved our workflow significantly.
vocabulary.translation: 新软件显著改善了我们的工作流程。

vocabulary.entry: process /ˈprəʊses/ n. 流程，步骤
vocabulary.example: The manufacturing process is highly automated.
vocabulary.translation: 生产过程高度自动化。

vocabulary.entry: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃnt/ adj. 高效的，有效率的
vocabulary.example: The new system is much more efficient than the old one.
vocabulary.translation: 新系统比旧系统高效得多。

vocabulary.definition: 使融入，整合到（固定表达）
vocabulary.entry: integrate into /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt ɪntə/ phr. v. 使融入，整合到（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The school aims to integrate technology into all subjects.
vocabulary.translation: 该校旨在将技术融入所有学科。

vocabulary.entry: career success /kəˈrɪə səkˈses/ n. 职业成功（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Effective communication is key to career success.
vocabulary.translation: 有效沟通是职业成功的关键。
